views.title: Academic calendar

sites.title: Electives and NEXUS Catalog
sites.audience: Students. Open to everyone.
sites.intro: Explore the career-exploration options offered to ISMMS students: electives, NEXUS Learning offerings, host institutions for away rotations, and what returning students said about them.

views.title: Electives catalog
views.blurb: All medical student electives, filterable by field, Area of Curricular Concentration, phase, and schedule. Built from the master electives catalog.

views.title: NEXUS offerings
views.blurb: The NEXUS Learning catalog with the same filters.

views.title: Away electives
views.blurb: Host institutions where students have completed extramural rotations.

views.title: Extramural ratings
views.blurb: Ratings and comments on host institutions from returning students.

sites.title: ASCEND Class Calendar
sites.audience: Office of Curricular Affairs staff, through their access code on the Hub.
sites.intro: For planning and review by the Office of Curricular Affairs only; not the schedule of record. The class schedule exactly as it stands in the Office of Curricular Affairs' Google Calendar, refreshed automatically every 30 minutes. Two small calendars for the current and next month sit at the top of every view; open on today's sessions with what is next up, see the week as a Monday-to-Friday board, or list every scheduled session grouped by module, by session type (LEC, SGD, CCSG, LAB, PNL, REV, INT and the assessments) or by week.

views.title: Today
views.blurb: The day at a glance: what is happening now or next, every session as a full card with time and type, and a preview of the next three class days. Opens by default.

views.title: Week
views.blurb: Monday to Friday, each session as a card, plus a strip of all-day items and quiz or pre-check windows that span several days.

views.title: All sessions
views.blurb: Every scheduled session from today onward (or the whole calendar), grouped by module, by session type or by week, with each group collapsible. Combine with the module or type filter to see one module's or one type's full schedule.

views.title: Cohort, module and type filters
views.blurb: Switch between class calendars (Class of 2029 and Class of 2030 in Phase 1, Class of 2027 in Year 4), pick one module, choose session types or assessments from a dropdown, show only mandatory sessions, or search any session by name.

views.title: Contact hours
views.blurb: A button on the calendar that totals the scheduled hours for a module, or for every module, in an academic year: instructional and assessment hours, a table by session type, and a CSV download. A planning estimate from the published calendar.

sites.title: Baby Bates
sites.audience: Students. Open to everyone.
sites.intro: A pocket clinical reference for history-taking and physical examination, drawn from Bates' Guide, to support clinical skills coaching and direct observation.

views.title: Core physical exam
views.blurb: The core exam and exam clusters by system.

views.title: Scripts and algorithms
views.blurb: Illness scripts, clinical scripts, and diagnostic algorithms.

views.title: Quick reference
views.blurb: Devices, labs, abbreviations, and structural vulnerability resources.

views.title: Practice of Medicine resources
views.blurb: Materials for coaching and direct observation in the POM modules.

sites.title: ASCEND Practice of Medicine (POM) Faculty Guides
sites.audience: Clinical Competency Mentors and the Office of Curricular Affairs. The guides are faculty material (scripts, expected answers, case findings), so the site sits behind its own server-side gate; your Hub code opens it if your role allows. Students use the matching POM Student Learning Guides on Baby Bates.
sites.intro: The Practice of Medicine faculty session guides for the POM 1 core physical exam, rebuilt as pages that read well on a laptop or phone. Each guide is the whole session: outline and timeline, the facilitator script with what to say and ask, the expected responses, and the exam checklist. The guide's faculty cues sit beside the script, with the Bates' Visual Guide video (and the time to skip to) and the Bates' Guide, 14th edition passage for each part of the exam.

views.title: Session 12: Cardiovascular
views.blurb: Vital signs, carotid arteries, the cardiac exam, peripheral pulses and edema.

views.title: Session 13: Cardiopulmonary
views.blurb: Chest landmarks, observing respiration, percussion, auscultation, and adding the cardiac exam.

views.title: Session 14: Abdominal
views.blurb: Illness scripts, the SP interview, inspection, auscultation, light and deep palpation, and the liver edge.

views.title: Session 15: Head, Neck & Cranial Nerves
views.blurb: Cranial nerves II–XII, otoscopy, the oral cavity, cervical lymph nodes, thyroid and carotids.

views.title: Faculty opportunities

sites.intro: Module-level outcomes for the pre-clerkship phase. Aggregate data by class cohort: how each module's assessments performed, what students said, and how the module maps to the program objectives.

views.title: Module dashboards
views.blurb: One page per module with grading structure, final and component results, NBME customized assessment and end-of-module exam statistics, quizzes, and cohort comparison.

views.title: All Phase 1 ASCEND Modules
views.blurb: Every module side by side, by class: final grades, the end-of-module exam (with NBME national means and reliability), the student evaluation's core questions, instructional time and learning objectives.

views.title: Student evaluations
views.blurb: Module evaluation results and trends.

views.title: Curricular hours and objective mapping
views.blurb: Hours by format, and module objectives mapped to program objectives.

views.title: Clinical skills
views.blurb: Practice of Medicine and PEAKS I clinical skills by domain, with faculty-group analytics and the competency framework crosswalk.

sites.title: Clinical Skills Portal
sites.audience: Clinical Skills: curriculum leadership, the governance committees that oversee clinical skills, and Clinical Competency Mentors. Clinical Skills Rubrics: a smaller group of faculty and staff, because it holds standardized-patient checklists, faculty-only rubrics and quiz answer keys. Clinical Skills Milestones: everyone who can open the portal (curriculum content, no student data). All three sit behind the portal's own server-side gate; your Hub code opens what your role allows.
sites.intro: Three separate dashboards behind one access code. Two cover the Practice of Medicine and PEAKS 1, linked by skill domain: how each class performed in each clinical skill, and the checklists, rubrics and quizzes that produced those scores. Each class runs POM 1 (August) to PEAKS 1 (December of the following year). The third, Clinical Skills Milestones, follows nine clinical skill strands across all three phases, from POM to residency.

views.title: Clinical Skills: Dashboard
views.blurb: Each class's strongest and weakest skill domains across POM 1, 2, 3 and PEAKS 1, with class comparison.

views.title: Clinical Skills: Analytics
views.blurb: Performance by skill, framework, quartile band or faculty group, with sortable heatmaps.

views.title: Clinical Skills: Frameworks
views.blurb: The six skill domains mapped to MEPOs, AAMC competencies, Core EPAs and communication functions.

views.title: Rubrics: Library and items
views.blurb: Every POM checklist, rubric, scoring guide and quiz answer key by class and term, searchable to the single item (faculty and staff only).

views.title: Rubrics: Crosswalk and Compare
views.blurb: One skill across every rubric that scores it, and any two deliveries of a rubric side by side.

views.title: Clinical Skills Milestones
views.blurb: Nine clinical skill strands across the three phase gates: the milestone at each gate, the behaviors a rater checks, where it is taught, in-course assessment and the PEAKS gate assessment (PEAKS III is the TTR final assessment).

sites.title: ASCEND Phase 2 Dashboard
sites.audience: Clerkship directors, the Clinical Curriculum Subcommittee, the Assessment and Evaluation Subcommittee, the EEC, and OCA leadership.
sites.intro: Clerkship-level outcomes for the clinical phase, plus program-wide clerkship monitoring across teaching sites. Aggregate data by academic year with prior-year comparison; student-level files go to directors separately.

views.title: Clerkship dashboards
views.blurb: One page per clerkship with grade distribution, NBME subject exam results by site, preceptor evaluation reliability, and direct-observation trends.

views.title: All Phase 2 ASCEND Clerkships
views.blurb: Every clerkship side by side on twelve shared measures — overall quality, mid-clerkship feedback and observation, clerkship and site evaluations, professionalism, CPE, shelf, direct observation, work hours, RCE logging, GQ and mistreatment — by class and by rotation.

views.title: Clerkship monitoring
views.blurb: LCME items by clerkship (feedback, direct observation, workload), site items by clerkship and teaching site, trends, and the GQ comparator, against an adjustable benchmark.

views.title: OAEA Clerkship Quality Monitor
views.blurb: Opens the OAEA Clerkship Quality Monitor: nine measures per clerkship compared across teaching sites and rotations, RCE completion and ALE use (LCME 6.2, 6.4, 8.6), plus the clinical site reports (one teaching site at a time).

views.title: Direct observations
views.blurb: Item-level standardized-patient performance by station and clerkship, mapped to the NBME physician tasks framework, with class-year trends since 2020-21 and the Legacy CDO Week 2026 (Class of 2027).

views.title: Assessment validity and reliability
views.blurb: Psychometric review of the preceptor evaluation forms, including internal consistency and dimensionality.

views.title: CAMP and Transition to Phase 2
views.blurb: Results for the bridging courses.

views.title: Objective mapping
views.blurb: Clerkship learning objectives mapped to program objectives.

sites.title: OAEA Clerkship Quality Monitor
sites.audience: Clerkship and site directors, the Clinical Curriculum Subcommittee, and OCA leadership.
sites.intro: Formerly Site Comparability. The quality of each Phase 2 clerkship on nine measures, compared across teaching sites and rotations, with RCE completion and ALE use, one clerkship at a time and across all clerkships, for the Class of 2028 (year to date) and the Class of 2027 where the data has a site split. Every figure is an aggregate; cells with fewer than five students are not shaded, and shading describes position only.

views.title: Overview
views.blurb: What each area holds, its coverage by class, and a sites-at-a-glance table of each site's difference from each clerkship's all-site figure.

views.title: Clinical site reports
views.blurb: One teaching site at a time: supervision and learning-environment items (LCME 9.3 and 3.5) against the other sites of the same clerkship, the prior year and the site's history.

views.title: 1. Overall quality of the clerkship
views.blurb: Overall quality of training at each site, every clerkship on one page.

views.title: 2. Mid-clerkship feedback
views.blurb: The site evaluation's feedback items by site, and the rate of students receiving mid-clerkship feedback in each clerkship (the clerkship evaluation is anonymous, so that rate has no site split).

views.title: 3. Clinical Performance Evaluations
views.blurb: Mean composite CPE score by the student's assigned site.

views.title: 4. NBME shelf exams
views.blurb: Subject-exam scores by the student's assigned site.

views.title: 5. Direct observation
views.blurb: Morchand Center checklist scores by the student's assigned site.

views.title: 6. Work hours
views.blurb: Students reporting a work-hour policy violation, by site.

views.title: 7. Professionalism
views.blurb: Every professionalism item on the site evaluation, by site.

views.title: 8. Mistreatment
views.blurb: Mistreatment by site: explains why no site-level figures are available for 2025–26 and 2026–27.

views.title: 9. RCE log completion
views.blurb: Students who logged every required clinical experience, by the student's assigned site.

sites.title: Nutrition Milestones
sites.audience: The Nutrition Content Area Director, module and clerkship directors, the Assessment and Evaluation Subcommittee, and OCA leadership. Draft content for review by the Nutrition Content Area Director, PCCS and CCS.
sites.intro: End-of-phase milestones for nutrition, built on the Milestones Map framework. It takes one competency from the JAMA nutrition competencies for medical students (Eisenberg et al., 2024), #5: assessing a patient's nutritional status with a brief diet history, measurements and lab tests. It follows that competency from the end of Phase 1 to residency readiness, and marks what is already taught and what is proposed.

views.title: Milestone statements
views.blurb: What a student must demonstrate at the end of Phase 1 (simulated), Phase 2 (core clerkships) and Phase 3 (Chronic Care Clerkship and Acting Internships), with Miller level, supervision and criterion.

views.title: Learning objectives

views.title: Teaching and assessment

views.title: Current coverage

sites.title: ASCEND Curricular Integration Dashboard
sites.audience: The Curricular Integration Subcommittee, AOC Directors, Content Area Directors, module and clerkship directors, the EEC and its subcommittees, and OCA leadership. Draft content for review by the Curricular Integration Subcommittee.
sites.intro: Where the four Areas of Curricular Concentration (AOCs: Healthcare Delivery Science, Scientific & Scholarly Discovery, Leadership & Professional Identity, Patient-Centered Advocacy), the ten content areas (curricular threads) and The Inquiry (THINQ) Curriculum live across the three phases of ASCEND. Breadth: which modules and clerkships carry each one. Depth: how many sessions and hours, and how Practice of Medicine skills progress. Alignment: which sessions carry objectives, MEPO links and summative assessment. Built from the AOC, thread and THINQ tabs of the master curriculum map; many tags still await director review.

views.title: Overview and breadth map
views.blurb: A card for each AOC, content area and THINQ with its lead, sessions, hours and phases (colour-coded Phase 1, 2, 3), and a map of sessions by module and clerkship. Select a card or cell for a side-panel summary, then open the full page.

views.title: Area profiles
views.blurb: One page per AOC or content area: sessions by module, subdomains, alignment to objectives, MEPOs and assessment, and (for Nutrition) coverage of the 36 JAMA competencies.

views.title: Floor and ceiling
views.blurb: For each AOC and content area, the topics integrated into modules and clerkships (the floor) beside the THINQ sessions that extend them (the ceiling).

views.title: Last CIS and EEC review
views.blurb: For each AOC and thread, a summary of its most recent review by the Curricular Integration Subcommittee and the EEC: what was presented, the vote, and the action items.

views.title: Explore sessions
views.blurb: Search and filter every mapped session, or every module and clerkship session to find ones that could carry a thread, by area, phase, module, MEPO or missing link. Download as CSV.

views.title: THINQ
views.blurb: THINQ 1, 2 and 3 by semester, with each session's AOC and the sessions still awaiting objectives.

views.title: Skill threads
views.blurb: The Practice of Medicine skill threads (communication, ethics, clinical reasoning and more) marked Introduced, Developed or Applied across POM 1, 2 and 3.

views.title: Gaps and alignment
views.blurb: For each area: sessions without objectives, MEPO links, summative assessment or hours, titles no longer on the current map, and areas still without a named lead.

sites.title: one45 Evaluations Library
sites.audience: Module and clerkship directors and coordinators, the Assessment and Evaluation Subcommittee, and Office of Curricular Affairs staff who write or review evaluation forms.
sites.intro: Every evaluation and assessment form that one45 has sent, or has scheduled, for academic year 2026-27 (1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027), in all four years: Phase 1 modules and electives, the Phase 2 clerkships and the Year 4 acting internships. Each form shows every question, instruction and answer choice as one45 displays it. The library holds form wording only: no responses, and no evaluator or student names. Pulled directly from one45 and refreshed on request.

views.title: Forms
views.blurb: All forms grouped by year and module or clerkship, with who completes each form, how many times one45 has sent it so far, and its full questions. Filter by year, form type or status, print one form, or copy a link to it.

views.title: Questions
views.blurb: Search a word or phrase (for example supervision, work hours or professionalism) and see every question that asks it, side by side across forms, with the form it comes from. Download the matching questions as a CSV.

sites.title: ASCEND Support Dashboard
sites.audience: Office of Curricular Affairs staff, governance support, and dashboard maintainers.
sites.intro: Five tools for the people who keep ASCEND running, behind one access code. Make a Word draft of meeting minutes from a transcript, build a module evaluation report from a one45 export, track mid-clerkship feedback, take student names out of a file before it goes in a dashboard inbox, or look up how a dashboard job is done. The Office of Curricular Affairs keeps a copy of each meeting transcript; the MCF Tracker keeps its rosters and logs as the record of mid-clerkship feedback; nothing else you upload to these tools is stored.

views.title: Meeting Minutes Generator
views.blurb: Drop in a Zoom or Teams transcript, or paste its text, and get a Word draft of the minutes: overview, decisions, action items with owners, and discussion by topic. The Office of Curricular Affairs keeps a copy of each transcript. Not for EEC, subcommittee or Monday Curricular Affairs minutes: those stay in the Governance dashboard.

views.title: Program Evaluation Report Generator
views.blurb: Upload a module's one45 evaluation export and get the Module Evaluation Report in Word, with rating charts, last year's ratings and Claude-coded comment themes, or download the latest finished report as a PDF.

views.title: Mid-Clerkship Feedback Tracker
views.blurb: Faculty log each mid-clerkship feedback meeting from a personal email link and students confirm it in a short survey aligned to LCME Element 9.7; see who is still missing, send reminders from Outlook, and download the inventory by rotation, faculty and student.

views.title: Remove Student Names
views.blurb: Take names, usernames, IDs and emails out of a gradebook or export inside your browser (nothing is uploaded), with or without a key, and save the DEID copy.

views.title: How-To Library
views.blurb: Plain-language guides for committee coordinators and dashboard maintainers: the Governance dashboard buttons, meeting files, checklists, and how each dashboard is kept up to date.
